name: project-map
description: Pre-map any project for coding agents: CLAUDE.md per area, a PROJECT_MAP.md that records what/where/why, engineering principles, and a local SQLite FTS5/BM25 index (optional embeddings) exposed as CLI + MCP tools, with agent notes that go stale when their files change.
